name: Habiganj
registryAssessment: A first-party Bangladesh Ministry of Land public map/procedure was evidenced, and its anonymous administrative cascade returned Sylhet division and Habiganj district. The next cascade level returned only Bahubal in the bounded response; Habiganj city/Sadar parcel coverage was not established. This is local public-service evidence, not proof of complete citywide cadastral coverage or legal-title access.

queries.query: Habiganj Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records map API site:gov.bd
queries.result: Found the official Ministry of Land Mouza and Plot Based National Digital Land Zoning viewer, the official DLRS settlement map-search portal, Habiganj district pages, and Survey of Bangladesh map-service material. The official viewer describes digitized/georeferenced mouza maps and plot selectors.

queries.query: হবিগঞ্জ সরকারি ভূমি নকশা মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান অনলাইন
queries.result: Found the official Bengali Ministry of Land map viewer, DLRS map-search service, Habiganj district land-record procedure material, and an official Habiganj land-office service page. These establish relevant public land-map/record procedures; no safe anonymous Habiganj parcel polygon was obtained.

officialSources.role: Bangladesh Ministry of Land public Mouza/plot land-zoning viewer
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 over TLS. Current HTML and JavaScript were inspected; the viewer exposes anonymous POST routes /getAdminByCode and /getGeomByCode and uses WKT administrative/plot geometry handling.

officialSources.role: Directorate of Land Records and Surveys public map-search procedure
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 over TLS. The page exposes division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet and dag/plot selectors.

officialSources.role: Habiganj district administration land-record procedure page
officialSources.observation: First-party district page describes applications for certified records and mouza maps; it is procedure evidence, not a parcel-vector API.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe stable native parcel identity and full parcel polygon were obtained. The public hierarchy returned Habiganj district but the bounded next-level response exposed Bahubal only; the official GeoServer capabilities request returned HTTP 503. No administrative geometry was retained as a parcel sample.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national mouza/plot digital land-zoning and DLRS map-search services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer availability and Habiganj district administrative listing were verified; Habiganj Sadar/city exact parcel inclusion, parcel schema/native ID, parcel CRS response, and citywide coverage were not verified.
